events.title: Devlog #2 - Working on the map
events.summary: Greetings everyone! It has been almost 2 weeks since my last devlog. Initially, I thought I would write here every week. I might do in the future but currently, since reception is low, I will try to focus my time in development instead. In my first log we spoke about UI and my struggle in finding a suitable font for numbers. Well, I found it! After a real struggle! You can see it below in the Contracts Negotiation UI: The whole game will have 3-4 fonts in total. The three are already in this UI.

events.title: Devlog #1 - UI Reveal
events.summary: It's 1970. You are birthing the Arcade industry. Arcade Warlord is inspired by Football Manager, Railroad Tycoon II, Software Inc and a little of Dwarf Fortress/Rimworld. It's a weird mixture I know. This first Devlog is about UI. I struggled a lot of deciding one single style for the UI. This is why I eventually built a Theme Engine. basic_info.short_description: A business strategy game set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, deploy specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and compete for strategic locations while managing the logistics of expansion.
